about: crates.io, the Rust package registry. This CLI searches crates and reads crate, version, dependency, download, owner, readme, source-file, advisory, docs.rs, user, team, category and keyword data through the public /api/v1 API.

commands.summary: Search or list crates by text query, with optional keyword/category/letter/user/team filters, sorting and pagination

params.name: all_keywords
params.description: Space-separated keywords that every crate must have, e.g. 'serde'

params.name: keyword
params.description: Only crates tagged with this single keyword, e.g. 'cli'

params.name: category
params.description: Only crates in this category slug, e.g. 'asynchronous' (see list-categories)

params.name: letter
params.description: Only crates whose name starts with this letter, e.g. 'S'

params.name: user_id
params.description: Only crates owned by this numeric user id (from get-user user.id or list-owners id)

params.name: team_id
params.description: Only crates owned by this numeric team id (from get-team team.id)

commands.summary: Get a crate's details: description, links, download totals, keywords, categories and default version
List all published versions of a crate, with downloads, yanked status, license and MSRV

params.name: sort
params.description: Order versions by publish date or by semver

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of versions to return (max 100)

commands.summary: Get details of one crate version: features, license, checksum, MSRV, edition, publisher
List the dependencies of a specific crate version, with version requirement, kind (normal/dev/build), optional flag and target
List crates that depend on a crate (dependents), sorted by the dependents' downloads

params.name: name
params.description: Crate name whose dependents to list

commands.summary: Get daily download counts for a crate over roughly the last 90 days, broken down by version id
Get daily download counts for one specific crate version
List the owners (users and GitHub teams) of a crate
Get the rendered README (HTML) of a specific crate version
List the files in a published crate version's source package, with sizes and sha256
List RustSec security advisories (OSV format) affecting a crate
Check whether docs.rs built documentation successfully for a crate version
Get a crates.io user's public profile (numeric id, name, GitHub link) by login
Get a crate-owning GitHub team's profile (numeric id, name, org URL) by team login

params.name: team
params.description: Team login in the form github:ORG:TEAM

commands.summary: List all crate categories with their slugs, descriptions and crate counts

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort alphabetically or by number of crates

commands.summary: Get one category's details, including subcategories, parent categories and crate count

params.name: slug
params.description: Category slug, e.g. asynchronous or web-programming::http-client

commands.summary: List crate keywords with crate counts, sorted by popularity or alphabetically

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by number of crates or alphabetically

commands.summary: Get the home-page summary: total crates and downloads, new, most-downloaded and just-updated crates, popular keywords and categories
